title: `_settleCurrency` does not properly interact with the `poolManager` when calling `settle`
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  After the swap is performed within the executor's `unlockCallback`, it will settle all the currency by triggering `_settleCurrency`. However, when settling currency on Uniswap V4's `poolManager`, the correct `settle` function is not used, causing the interaction with Uniswap V4 to always fail.  ```solidity     function _settleCurrency(Currency currency) internal {         int256 amount = poolManager.currencyDelta(address(this), currency);         if (amount < 0) {             // address(this) owes PoolManager currency
